subtitle: Lesson 30 · Update Sets & Change Management (Admin View)

steps.label: 1. Set Current
steps.sub: pick/create the Update Set in the top picker BEFORE touching anything

steps.label: 2. Make changes
steps.sub: customizations are captured automatically as you work

steps.label: 3. Review
steps.sub: open the related list -- confirm it holds exactly what you intended

steps.label: 4. Complete
steps.sub: lock it as finished and ready to export/promote

code:
Wrong order:                        Right order:
1. edit Business Rule                1. create + switch to
2. create new Update Set,                "Fix for Incident Routing"
   switch to it                      2. edit Business Rule
-> edit already landed in           -> edit lands in the
   Default, not the new one             intended Update Set
caption: Changes go to whatever is Current at the moment you make them -- not after.

code:
Default Update Set:
  - catch-all when nothing else is Current
  - accumulates unrelated changes over time
  - rarely promoted to another instance as-is

Finding your work in Default
  = signal you skipped step one
caption: Default exists so changes always land somewhere -- not so you should use it on purpose.

code:
Open the Update Set's related list and check:
  1. missing  -- work you meant to include
                 that landed somewhere else
  2. extra    -- unrelated changes that snuck in
                 while this one was current

Clean, single-purpose Update Set
  = easier to promote, easier to troubleshoot
caption: Review catches both problems before Complete locks it in.
